If someone is white then they are nice. If someone is white then they are nice. All nice, green people are young. If someone is green then they are quiet. Nice people are kind. Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Anne is young.

Kind(Dave, True) && White(Dave, True) >>> Blue(Dave, True) ::: If Dave is kind and Dave is white then Dave is blue.

Blue(Dave, True) >>> White(Dave, True) ::: If Dave is blue then Dave is white.

Query:
Young(Anne, True) ::: Anne is young.
